title: Tesla valvular one-way line filter
spec: Keep only brief lines whose tokens intersect the query (one-way: non-matching lines never flow into the brief).
target: allsee brief bodies on c1 qa_set

title: Free-energy / entropy sentence budget
spec: Keep sentence s iff marginal query-term info (idf-weighted coverage + numeric bonus) > T·√tokens(s). T tuned on DEV.
result: T=1.5 → tokens 1324.0 (−23% vs valve, −43% vs raw); R@5/acc held. Stack with #5 → 782.2 (−66% vs raw).

title: Landauer bit-budget / score-gap adaptive k
spec: Cap hits by cumulative softmax self-information (bits) or shrink k when top-1 score gap is large.
metric: tokens_brief (↓) with R@5/acc held on DEV
result: Bit-budget B≤10 and gap-k thr≤0.5 all either cut DEV recall or matched valve tokens (noop on TEST). No measurable win.

title: Simulated-annealing context prune
spec: SA over sentence subset maximizing idf-coverage − λ·tokens (300 iters).
result: DEV only λ=0 keeps acc (tokens 1207); λ>0 collapses acc. TEST λ=0 → 1657, worse than free-energy. Dropped.

title: Cross-hit entropy-zero line dedup
spec: Normalize lines to token-sets; drop repeats across the 5-hit brief (zero new information).
result: tokens 1088.4 (−37% vs valve). Stack #2+#5: 782.2 (−66% vs raw).

title: Tesla resonance query-order batching
spec: Reorder TEST queries by rarest term so hot FTS pages stay warm.
target: allsee search wall time over TEST
result: resonant 13409 ms (0.98×). No win — FTS cache already warm.

title: Bifilar dual-path query cache
spec: Path A: exact string. Path B: normalized sorted token-set. Zipf stream of 600 real queries with case/space variants.
result: bifilar hit 0.707, 10.38s (−24% vs exact, −72% vs cold).

title: Canon-path LRU / idf warm memo
spec: lru_cache on allsee.canon; compare cold vs warm idf.
result: memo p50 57ms (no gain); idf warm 14.19s (1.005×). Dropped.

title: Thermal-aware ncand under contention
spec: If load1 > 0.75·ncpu (or under N-way parallel searchers), cut ncand 30→15. Accuracy verified equal on TEST.
result: ncand15 wall_max 6.30s (−12%); recall5/acc unchanged. Solo gain <5% so gate is contention.

title: Pixel/image memory palace (ahash+dhash)
spec: Perceptual hashes (8×8 aHash + dHash, Hamming≤5) dedup screenshots/icons into a palace; compare to sha1.
metric: bytes saved vs raw and vs sha1
result: perceptual-unique 246.3 MB (281 files); −12.8% vs raw; −28.7 MB beyond sha1 near-dupes.

title: Shared agent state file (act as one)
spec: 5 agents × 40 queries: first writer fills normalized-key state JSON; others read hits, no re-search.

title: Valvular one-way bus id dedup
spec: Tesla-valve on collab JSONL: only first sighting of each message id forwards; replays blocked.

title: Zipf / resonance boot prefetch
spec: Prefetch top-50 zipf-popular queries into bifilar token-set cache at boot.

title: Thermodynamic η=acc/tokens selector
spec: On DEV, pick config maximizing η=1000·acc/tokens_brief among {raw,valve,fe,dedup,stack}; apply to TEST.
result: picks stack η 2.803 (×10.5); TEST tokens 782.2, R@5/acc held. Correctly ranks free-energy+dedup.

title: SQLite mmap hardware path
spec: PRAGMA mmap_size=256MB on read-only allsee.db (OS page cache maps index).
result: mmap p50 42.4 ms (−29%), tot 10140 (−29%), R@5 0.9674. cache_size alone did not help.
